authorization: Jordan: yep brief it and get a coder on it.
approved_extension: ParsedCommand gains PijQuery(PijQueryCommand); PijTarget explicitly carries deferred SessionShow/SourceCheck. This new authorised selector was not in historical C20 enumeration, but preserves its parse-once typed-dispatch invariant.
core_contracts_unchanged: No QueryRequest, QueryApi, QuerySource, QueryAdapter, QueryWriter or native source-identity schema changed for Pij.

nonblocking_decisions.exit_status: Pij lookup failures are operational exit1; stable UNI-PIJ-* codes distinguish unknown seat, missing native ID, unavailable lookup and missing transcript. No new numeric exit taxonomy.
nonblocking_decisions.executable_lookup: Retain existing POSIX PATH resolution shared with trusted Git lookup, including caller-configured relative entries. Callers control PATH; no implicit installation or daemon lifecycle repair. No separate Pij lookup convention introduced.
nonblocking_decisions.cwd: Returned cwd/machine stay untrusted hints and are not opened or displayed. Native metadata discovery then explicit SourceId scope makes Pij identity lookup independent of current repository association; M1 was disproved by actual runtime comparison.
